title: The skyscraper that melts cars
caption:
London built a skyscraper that doubled as a giant magnifying glass. ☀️
A concave face works like a curved mirror: it gathers sunlight from a wide area and focuses it into one hot spot on the street.
Would you have tried the egg?
sources: BBC News, September 2013: 20 Fenchurch Street ('Walkie-Talkie') reflected sunlight melted parts of a parked Jaguar; a reporter fried an egg; nicknamed the 'Walkie-Scorchie'
City of London / BBC, 2014: permanent sunshade (brise soleil) fitted
